findings.text: non-blocking: assert PROGRAM_THAT_EXISTS_NOWHERE in message is satisfied by the CrewError's own {command!r} echo at reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:711, so it holds even if the refusal names argv[0] instead of the program the resolver read; only the following "'env'" not in message line actually catches that regression.

non-blocking: the reuse control cited in test_logs and in the landing fragment carries no revision header, no literal command line and no closing EXIT= record, so a reader cannot tell which tree it measured.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit: 8311322524 adds the resolver and the not-started reporting, 78755444 moves the resolver into promotion_gate and deletes landing_measure's copies, 67b19df7 consolidates _SHELL_ASSIGNMENT and _is_executable_file to one definition each and makes the guard pass the interpreter fallback, and 0e8e9dd0 is docs-only.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the three cases now at tests/test_a_gate_that_cannot_start_names_its_program.py:70, :95 and :131; after_suite-1795347332897345389.log records 65 passed EXIT=0 at 67b19df7 and negative-control-base.log records 3 failed EXIT=1 at dde7b001, the first reading verdict=failed exit_status=127 with "the merge changes what this node's gate proves".
item_verdicts.goal: the node's deliverable is that a merged-head gate replay which cannot start its program says so instead of blaming the merge; reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:1311 resolves the program before the shell receives it and :1322-1337 reports not-run naming the program and the tree.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, baseline_suite 58 passed and after_suite 65 passed with no failure ids, three control logs recorded with their failure counts, and the pre-existing test_crew_gate_command_is_runnable failure recorded under outside_scope.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the delivered diff dde7b001..0e8e9dd0 touches only reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py, the new test and the landing fragment; reckon/crew/landing_measure.py is declared and nets zero because its resolver copy was added and removed inside the range, so every path is inside the declared set.

justifications.durability: negative-control-duplicate-helpers.log shows four cases including the helper-count and rewrite cases red at b55533df9d, but tests/test_a_gate_that_cannot_start_names_its_program.py:246 passes on the command echo and so does not guard the refusal it claims to.
justifications.evidence: after_suite-1795347332897345389.log carries revision, command, 65 passed and EXIT=0, and negative-control-base.log reproduces the defect at dde7b001, but negative-control-reuse.log has no header and no EXIT= record.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:466 takes the env-unwrapping walk into one helper with a docstring stating the mechanism, and no added name carries a plan, stage or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:1311 resolves the program and :1339 rewrites it into the command, while :1474-1494 classify exit 127 as not-run, so all three done-when outcomes are carried by the landed code.
justifications.reuse: the resolver at promotion_gate.py:498-645 is the only owner of gate-program resolution in reckon, it reuses fleet_supervisor's resolved_environment, and the nearest neighbours (dispatch_launch.py:1364 backend-binary resolution, process_liveness.py:178 scheduler lookup) are different capabilities.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in dde7b001..0e8e9dd0 is inside the declared set and no figure directory or unrelated module is touched.
